rubric.criterion: Lists the assets, names at least three trust boundaries, covers all 8 components and uses the STRIDE categories, with a likelihood, an impact and a mitigation for each threat.

Finds the guessable 6-character token (TM1), the file served before the scan finishes (TM2) and the links and download URLs that never or slowly expire (TM3), each tied to the flow in the description.
Finds that the admin endpoints check only a valid session (TM6), that password attempts are unlimited and uploads have no size limit (TM5), and the weak password hash (TM8).
Finds the missing audit trail for downloads and admin actions (TM4), the email that carries the link and file name with optional TLS (TM7) and the unspecified cookie protections (TM9).
Does not claim a control that the description lacks (rate limiting, scan before download, server-side admin checks, salted hashes), invents no component, and rates TM1, TM2 and TM6 at least medium.
